clue.text: Plant book rating only 4/10

indicators.note: the two words book and rating hold ten letters between them, and only four of them, from the middle, are taken

explanation.surface: A gardening book gets a poor review: four out of ten.
explanation.walkthrough: '4/10' looks like a review score, but it says to take four letters of the ten in 'book rating', the middle run.
explanation.definitionFit: Okra is a flowering plant of the mallow family grown for its edible green pods.

clue.text: Rock's alleged King of Scotland's set up in Scottish port

indicators.note: the reversed name and its S sit inside the port

parts.note: Oban is a port on the west coast of Scotland

parts.note: Idi Amin, Uganda's dictator, styled himself the Last King of Scotland; IDI plus the 's

explanation.surface: A rock said to belong to a Scottish king is put up in a harbour town.
explanation.walkthrough: Idi Amin's self-awarded title was the basis of the film The Last King of Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Obsidian is a dark glassy volcanic rock.

clue.text: Maybe Caesar and soldiers heading north over isle

in a down clue, going north means read upwards, backwards

parts.note: OR stands for Other Ranks, ordinary soldiers
the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: Caesar and his legions march north across an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Julius Caesar is an example of a citizen of ancient Rome.

clue.text: No-hope candidates giving messages better not received?

pieces of information that give away a film or book's plot before you see it

explanation.surface: An election campaign where hopeless candidates send out unwelcome mail.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are everyday uses: a hopeless candidate who wrecks another's chances, and a plot reveal you would rather not hear.

clue.text: Yearns for something useless

definitions.meaning: British slang for rubbish, worthless stuff

explanation.surface: Someone longs for a thing of no value.
explanation.definitionFit: To pant after is to long for something, and in British slang anything rubbish is called pants.

clue.text: This could be changed in dingier store

definitions.text: This could be changed in dingier store

indicators.note: the letters of the two words after it are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: A shabby shop might need its decor revamped.
explanation.definitionFit: Interior design is the planning of a room's decoration, exactly what a shabby shop would have redone.

clue.text: Oriental season with emperor briefly appearing

parts.note: Easter is a season of the church year

indicators.note: the emperor's name is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: Nero was a Roman emperor

explanation.surface: A man from the East comes along at Easter with a Roman ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: An Oriental is a person from the East, as is an Easterner.

clue.text: Stamp shows mammal

definitions.meaning: an official mark pressed into wax or paper

explanation.surface: A postage stamp depicting an animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A seal is both an embossed stamp of authority and a sea-dwelling mammal.

clue.text: In terms of how things are put across, there could be potential snare

indicators.note: the letters of the two words might be formed into another word

explanation.surface: A warning that how something is phrased might trap you.
explanation.definitionFit: Presentational means relating to presentation, the manner in which information is conveyed.

clue.text: Dotty old Bob was an habitual boozer

parts.note: a bob was a shilling in old British money, abbreviated S
to tipple is to drink alcohol habitually

explanation.surface: Old Bob, a heavy drinker, has gone a bit mad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bob' looks like a man's name; it is the shilling, a coin of pre-decimal British money.
explanation.definitionFit: Stippled means marked with many small dots, a painting or engraving technique.

clue.text: Helpful type married a woman in hospital

indicators.note: the married woman sits inside the word for hospital

parts.note: SAN is short for sanatorium, a hospital
Rita is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A kind person weds a woman who is a patient in hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: From the parable of the Good Samaritan, the name is used for anyone who helps a stranger in need.

clue.text: Bill, drunk, knocked over operatic singer

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill
a sot is a habitual drunk

explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' looks like a man's name but is an account, AC.
explanation.definitionFit: Floria Tosca is the title character of Puccini's opera, herself a celebrated singer in the story.

clue.text: After playing, pianists shared bits of food

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are rearranged, as if played about with

clue.text: Tree as located at front of enclosure

parts.note: a pen is an enclosure for animals

explanation.definitionFit: The aspen is a kind of poplar known for its trembling leaves.

clue.text: Poor signs could make this look bad

clue.text: Quiet worker may be biased

clue.text: Tiredness apt to be modified by a new sort of drug

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are changed into a new order

ile is French for island

clue.text: Open market
